steps.title: Verify Emergency Backup Motor Gear Alignment
steps.instruction: Inspect the backup motor's alignment with the main pedestal gear. Measure the teeth clearance using a feeler gauge and confirm it falls within the 0.5mm - 0.8mm tolerance range. If misalignment is detected, consult the site administrator before performing manual adjustment.
steps.acceptance: Clearance measurement logged; confirmation of gear alignment achieved or adjustment approved by supervisor.
